keyEvents.text: Lewie Coyle (Hull City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half begins Arsenal 0, Hull City 0.
Lucas Gourna-Douath (Hull City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Hull City. Joe Gelhardt replaces Mohamed-Ali Cho.
Substitution, Hull City. Brooke Norton-Cuffy replaces Lewie Coyle.
Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Hull City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Arsenal. Mikel Merino replaces Declan Rice.
Substitution, Arsenal. Viktor Gyökeres replaces Kai Havertz.
Delay in match because of an injury Semi Ajayi (Hull City).
Substitution, Arsenal. Eberechi Eze replaces Christos Tzolis.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Arsenal. Piero Hincapié replaces Riccardo Calafiori.
Substitution, Hull City. Lucas Herrington replaces Semi Ajayi because of an injury.
Goal! Arsenal 1, Hull City 0. Martin Ødegaard (Arsenal) right footed shot from the right side of the six yard box to the bottom right corner.
Elliot Stroud (Hull City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Hull City. Ryan Giles replaces Elliot Stroud.
Substitution, Hull City. Christos Mouzakitis replaces Tim Iroegbunam.
